narrative_engine.thesis: trend down regime (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -2.94 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP), but price sits 2.69σ from the Day VWAP — chasing here pays no edge. Working limit order at the trend-side band 0.04705-0.04727; the offer is earned when footprint absorption or a strong divergence prints at the zone.
